record.question: In Mizo traditional society 'Pawlkut' was generally celebrated in the month of?
record.explanation: Answer C: December or January. Pawlkut is the traditional rice/paddy-harvest festival celebrated in December or January. The original Census 2011 Lunglei district handbook explicitly identifies those months. Reference: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/883/download/36400/DH_2011_1506_PART_B_DCHB_LUNGLEI.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
